svg.title: pop(0) versus pop()
svg.desc: Test 4 on the 4 by 4 grid, from (0, 0) to (3, 0) with (1, 0) and (1, 1) blocked. Left, with pop(0), oldest first, breadth-first search finds a 7-step path: across to (0, 2), down column 2 to (3, 2), then left along the bottom to (3, 0). Right, with pop(), newest first, the search dives down one route and returns a 9-step path: all the way across to (0, 3), down to (2, 3), back left along row 2 to (2, 0), then down to (3, 0).
svg.text: 9 steps: it dove down one route
